encyclopaedia.en: I look up animals in the encyclopaedia.
encyclopaedia.cn: 我在百科全书里查动物。

encyclopaedia.en: An encyclopaedia gives us knowledge about almost everything.
encyclopaedia.cn: 百科全书几乎能给我们各种知识。

volume.en: Each volume of the set covers a different subject.
volume.cn: 这套书的每一卷涵盖不同的主题。

information.en: I found a lot of information online.
information.cn: 我在网上找到了很多信息。

information.en: We can search the website for more information about it.
information.cn: 我们可以在网站上搜索更多相关信息。

subject.cn: 历史是一门有趣的学科。

subject.en: The article covers a difficult subject in simple words.
subject.cn: 这篇文章用简单的语言讲解了一个难懂的主题。

knowledge.en: Books give us a lot of knowledge.
We get knowledge about the world from encyclopaedias.
knowledge.cn: 我们从百科全书中获得关于世界的知识。

search.en: I search the Internet for answers.
You can search for the topic by typing key words.
search.cn: 你可以通过输入关键词来搜索这个话题。

article.en: I read an article about animals.
article.cn: 我读了一篇关于动物的文章。

article.en: This article gives detailed information on the topic.
article.cn: 这篇文章对该话题给出了详细的信息。

topic.en: We talked about an interesting topic.
topic.cn: 我们谈论了一个有趣的话题。

topic.en: Each article on the website focuses on one topic.
topic.cn: 网站上每篇文章都聚焦一个话题。

index.en: Use the index to find the page.
The index at the back helps you find topics quickly.
index.cn: 书后的索引能帮你快速找到话题。

website.en: This website includes articles on many different subjects.
website.cn: 这个网站收录了许多不同学科的文章。

detail.en: The encyclopaedia explains the topic in great detail.
detail.cn: 百科全书非常详细地解释了这个话题。

quickly.en: I can find the word quickly.
A good index helps us find information quickly.
quickly.cn: 好的索引能帮我们快速找到信息。

include.en: The encyclopaedia includes articles on history and science.
include.cn: 这套百科全书收录了历史和科学方面的文章。

publish.en: They publish a new volume every year.
publish.cn: 他们每年出版一卷新书。

publish.en: This encyclopaedia was first published a hundred years ago.
publish.cn: 这套百科全书于一百年前首次出版。

expert.en: He is an expert on animals.
The articles are written by experts in each subject.
expert.cn: 这些文章由各学科的专家撰写。

number.en: We use numbers to count things every day.
number.cn: 我们每天用数字来数东西。

count.en: The baby can count to twenty.
Let's count the number of students in the class.
count.cn: 我们来数一数班里的学生人数。

billion.en: China has over one billion people.
There are billions of stars in the night sky.
billion.cn: 夜空中有数十亿颗星星。

million.en: The city has two million people.
Millions of people use the Internet every day.
million.cn: 每天有数百万人使用互联网。

thousand.en: There are a thousand seats here.
The library keeps thousands of old books.
thousand.cn: 这座图书馆藏有数千本旧书。

hundred.en: Hundreds of years ago, people had no computers.
hundred.cn: 几百年前，人们没有电脑。

equal.en: Two plus two is equal to four.
Everyone should have equal chances to learn.
equal.cn: 每个人都应有平等的学习机会。

plus.en: If you add three plus four, you get seven.

minus.en: When you do minus, the number gets smaller.

multiply.en: Multiply three by four to get twelve.
We multiply numbers to make adding faster.
multiply.cn: 我们用乘法让加法更快。

divide.en: Divide ten by five to get two.
Let's divide the cake equally among us.
divide.cn: 我们把蛋糕平均分给大家。

math.en: Math helps us solve problems in daily life.
math.cn: 数学帮我们解决日常生活中的问题。

lucky.en: Eight is a lucky number in China.
lucky.cn: 在中国，八是个幸运数字。

lucky.en: Many people think some numbers are lucky.
lucky.cn: 许多人认为有些数字是幸运的。

ancient.en: Ancient people used stones to count.
This ancient story has been told for thousands of years.
ancient.cn: 这个古老的故事已流传了数千年。

common.en: This is a common word in English.
common.cn: 这是英语里一个常见的词。

common.en: It is common to use numbers in our daily life.
common.cn: 在日常生活中使用数字是很常见的。

computer.en: I do my homework on the computer.
Computers help us search and store lots of information.
computer.cn: 电脑帮我们搜索和存储大量信息。

keyboard.en: Learning to use the keyboard helps you type quickly.
keyboard.cn: 学会用键盘能帮你快速打字。

screen.en: The words are on the screen.
Looking at the screen too long is bad for your eyes.
screen.cn: 看屏幕太久对眼睛不好。

mouse.en: Click the file with the mouse.
Move the mouse to open the folder on the screen.
mouse.cn: 移动鼠标打开屏幕上的文件夹。

file.en: I saved the file on my computer.
Remember to keep your important files in a safe folder.
file.cn: 记得把重要文件放在安全的文件夹里。

folder.en: Put the file in this folder.
folder.cn: 把文件放进这个文件夹。

folder.en: I keep all my photos in one folder on the computer.
folder.cn: 我把所有照片放在电脑的一个文件夹里。

Internet.en: I find news on the Internet.
The Internet connects people all over the world.
Internet.cn: 互联网把全世界的人连接起来。

program.en: This program helps us draw pictures on the computer.
program.cn: 这个程序帮我们在电脑上画图。

download.en: I download films from the Internet.
You can download the file and open it later.
download.cn: 你可以把文件下载下来稍后打开。

upload.cn: 她把作业上传到了网上。

upload.en: Please upload the file to the website before Friday.
upload.cn: 请在周五前把文件上传到网站。

email.en: I got an email from my friend.
email.cn: 我收到朋友的一封电子邮件。

email.en: You can send the file to me by email.
email.cn: 你可以通过电子邮件把文件发给我。

password.en: You need a password to open your email.
password.cn: 你需要密码才能打开邮箱。

type.en: Type the key words to search for the topic.
type.cn: 输入关键词来搜索这个话题。

store.en: Computers can store lots of data.
We store our photos and files on the computer.
store.cn: 我们把照片和文件存在电脑上。

useful.en: The computer is a useful tool.
The Internet is useful for finding information.
useful.cn: 互联网对查找信息很有用。

invention.en: The phone is a useful invention.
invention.cn: 电话是一项有用的发明。

invention.en: The computer is one of the greatest inventions in history.
invention.cn: 电脑是历史上最伟大的发明之一。

inventor.cn: 爱迪生是一位伟大的发明家。

inventor.en: The inventor spent years making his new machine.
inventor.cn: 这位发明家花了多年制造他的新机器。

discover.en: Scientists discover new things every year.
discover.cn: 科学家每年都有新发现。

discover.en: People discovered how to make paper long ago.
discover.cn: 人们很久以前就发现了造纸的方法。

machine.en: The steam engine changed the way machines work.
machine.cn: 蒸汽机改变了机器的运转方式。

engine.en: The car has a powerful engine.
engine.cn: 这辆车有强劲的发动机。

engine.en: The steam engine was an important invention in history.
engine.cn: 蒸汽机是历史上一项重要的发明。

steam.en: Early trains were driven by steam power.
steam.cn: 早期的火车靠蒸汽动力驱动。

modern.en: Many modern inventions make our life easier.
modern.cn: 许多现代发明让我们的生活更轻松。

history.en: Many great inventions changed the course of history.
history.cn: 许多伟大的发明改变了历史的进程。

century.en: The car was invented in the 19th century.
Over the centuries, machines have become much smarter.
century.cn: 几个世纪以来，机器变得聪明多了。

change.cn: 电脑改变了我们的生活。

change.en: New inventions can change the way we live and work.
change.cn: 新发明能改变我们生活和工作的方式。

paper.en: Paper was one of the great inventions of ancient China.
paper.cn: 纸是中国古代的伟大发明之一。

compass.en: A compass shows us the way.
The compass helped sailors find their way at sea.
compass.cn: 指南针帮助水手在海上辨明方向。

printing.cn: 印刷术有助于制作许多书。

printing.en: Printing made it easy to share knowledge with everyone.
printing.cn: 印刷术让知识能轻松地与所有人分享。

gunpowder.en: Gunpowder is one of the four great inventions of China.
gunpowder.cn: 火药是中国四大发明之一。

memory.en: She has a very good memory.
We can train our memory with the right methods.
memory.cn: 我们能用正确的方法训练记忆力。

remember.en: Repeating new words often helps us remember them.
remember.cn: 经常重复生词有助于我们记住它们。

forget.en: If you don't review, you will forget what you learn.
forget.cn: 如果不复习，你会忘记所学的内容。

mind.en: Keep the picture in your mind.
A calm mind helps you remember things better.
mind.cn: 平静的头脑能帮你更好地记住事物。

brain.en: Doing puzzles is a good exercise for the brain.
brain.cn: 做谜题是很好的大脑锻炼。

review.en: I review my notes every evening.
If you review often, you will not forget the words.
review.cn: 如果经常复习，你就不会忘记单词。

repeat.en: Repeating the words many times helps you remember them.
repeat.cn: 多次重复单词能帮你记住它们。

method.en: This is a useful study method.
method.cn: 这是个有用的学习方法。

method.en: A good method can improve your memory a lot.
method.cn: 好的方法能大大提高你的记忆力。

trick.en: I know a trick to remember words.
trick.cn: 我有一个记单词的技巧。

trick.en: Using pictures is a good trick for remembering words.
trick.cn: 用图像是记单词的好技巧。

image.en: I keep an image of it in my mind.
image.cn: 我把它的图像记在脑海里。

image.en: Turning words into images makes them easier to remember.
image.cn: 把单词变成图像会让它们更易记住。

picture.en: Draw a picture of the word.
Linking a word to a picture helps your memory.
picture.cn: 把单词和图画联系起来有助于记忆。

concentrate.en: I can't concentrate in a noisy room.
concentrate.cn: 在吵闹的房间里我无法集中注意力。

concentrate.en: When you concentrate, you remember things more easily.
concentrate.cn: 当你专心时，记东西会更容易。

distract.en: Turn off your phone so it won't distract you.
distract.cn: 关掉手机，免得它让你分心。

quiz.en: A quiz helps you check how much you remember.
quiz.cn: 小测验能帮你检查记住了多少。

improve.en: I want to improve my English.
Good methods can help you improve your memory.
improve.cn: 好的方法能帮你提高记忆力。

legend.en: This is a famous Chinese legend.
legend.cn: 这是一个著名的中国传说。

legend.en: The legend tells of a brave hero and a dragon.
legend.cn: 这个传说讲述了一位勇敢英雄和一条龙。

myth.en: Ancient myths often explain how the world began.
myth.cn: 古代神话常解释世界是如何起源的。

hero.en: In the legend, the brave hero fought the dragon.
hero.cn: 在传说中，勇敢的英雄与龙搏斗。

king.en: The king lived in a castle.
The wise king ruled the country for many years.
king.cn: 这位睿智的国王统治这个国家许多年。

queen.en: The queen wore a beautiful dress.
queen.cn: 王后穿着一条漂亮的裙子。

queen.en: The king and queen lived happily in the castle.
queen.cn: 国王和王后在城堡里幸福地生活。

battle.en: The hero showed great courage in the battle.
battle.cn: 英雄在战斗中表现出极大的勇气。

dragon.en: The dragon lived in the mountain.
In Chinese legends, the dragon is a symbol of power.
dragon.cn: 在中国传说里，龙是力量的象征。

god.en: People prayed to the god for rain.
In the myth, the god created the sun and the moon.
god.cn: 在神话中，神创造了太阳和月亮。

magic.en: The story is full of magic.
The old man used magic to help the poor hero.
magic.cn: 老人用魔法帮助了贫穷的英雄。

brave.en: The brave knight was not afraid of the dragon.
brave.cn: 勇敢的骑士不怕那条龙。

clever.en: The clever boy solved the problem.
clever.cn: 聪明的男孩解决了问题。

clever.en: The clever hero used a trick to beat the giant.
clever.cn: 聪明的英雄用计谋打败了巨人。

Emperor.en: The Emperor lived in the palace.
The ancient Emperor ruled over a huge country.
Emperor.cn: 这位古代皇帝统治着一个庞大的国家。

castle.en: The king lives in a big castle.
castle.cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。

castle.en: The castle on the hill is hundreds of years old.
castle.cn: 山上的城堡有几百年的历史了。

journey.cn: 他们开始了一段危险的旅程。

journey.en: The hero set out on a long journey to save the queen.
journey.cn: 英雄踏上漫长的旅程去拯救王后。

season.en: There are four seasons in a year.
Each season has its own kind of weather.
season.cn: 每个季节都有自己特有的天气。

climate.en: Southern cities have a warmer climate than northern ones.
climate.cn: 南方城市比北方城市气候更暖和。

weather.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
weather.cn: 天气预报说明天会下雨。

temperature.en: In summer the temperature can be very high.

thunder.en: Thunder and lightning often come with a summer storm.
thunder.cn: 雷电常伴随夏季的暴风雨而来。

storm.en: The storm brought heavy rain and strong winds.
storm.cn: 暴风雨带来了大雨和强风。

typhoon.en: A typhoon often brings heavy rain in late summer.
typhoon.cn: 台风常在夏末带来暴雨。

fog.en: Drivers must be careful in the heavy fog.
fog.cn: 司机在浓雾中必须小心。

dry.en: The northern part of the country is hot and dry.
dry.cn: 这个国家的北部又热又干。

wet.en: The ground is wet after rain.
The weather is wet and rainy in this season.
wet.cn: 这个季节天气潮湿多雨。

degree.en: The temperature dropped below zero degrees at night.
degree.cn: 夜间温度降到了零度以下。

northern.en: Winter is cold in northern cities.
The northern part of the country has long, cold winters.
northern.cn: 这个国家的北部冬季漫长而寒冷。

southern.en: Summer is hot in southern cities.
Southern areas usually have more rainfall than northern ones.
southern.cn: 南方地区的降雨通常比北方多。

forecast.en: I watch the forecast every night.
The forecast says a typhoon will come this weekend.
forecast.cn: 预报说这个周末会有台风。

rainfall.en: There is little rainfall in the desert.
The rainfall in summer is much heavier than in winter.
rainfall.cn: 夏季的降雨量比冬季大得多。

English.en: We take part in many activities during English week.
English.cn: 在英语周里我们参加许多活动。

speech.en: He gave a speech in English.
She practised her speech many times before the contest.
speech.cn: 比赛前她把演讲练习了许多次。

play.en: We put on a play in English.
play.cn: 我们用英语演了一出戏。

play.en: The students acted in an English play on the stage.
play.cn: 学生们在舞台上表演了一出英语戏剧。

contest.en: Many students took part in the English speech contest.
contest.cn: 许多学生参加了英语演讲比赛。

audience.en: The audience enjoyed the wonderful performance very much.
audience.cn: 观众非常喜欢这场精彩的表演。

performance.en: The whole audience clapped after the performance.
performance.cn: 表演结束后全场观众都鼓掌了。

stage.en: The actors walked onto the stage to loud applause.
stage.cn: 演员们在热烈的掌声中走上舞台。

prize.en: She won a prize in the contest.
The best speaker got the first prize in the contest.
prize.cn: 最佳演讲者获得了比赛的一等奖。

competition.en: The competition gave students a chance to show their skills.
competition.cn: 竞赛给了学生展示才能的机会。

practise.en: She practised her play many times to do it well.
practise.cn: 为了演好，她把戏练习了许多次。

confident.en: She is confident on the stage.
With enough practice, you will feel more confident.
confident.cn: 充分练习后，你会感到更自信。

nervous.en: I was nervous before the speech.
Don't be nervous; just speak slowly and clearly.
nervous.cn: 别紧张，慢慢地、清楚地说就好。

role.en: She played the role of a queen.
role.cn: 她扮演了王后这个角色。

role.en: He played an important role in the school play.
role.cn: 他在校园戏剧中扮演了一个重要角色。

applause.en: The singer got lots of applause.
The performance ended with warm applause from the audience.
applause.cn: 表演在观众热烈的掌声中结束。

organise.en: Our class organised a wonderful English speech contest.
organise.cn: 我们班组织了一场精彩的英语演讲比赛。
